purpose: Gas-phase CH3OH reference for T1.18 adsorption energy (vacuum convention).
note: methanol, closed-shell singlet. Convention note: G(CH3OH) here is the ISOLATED-GAS reference; if the T1.18 formula requires a liquid/solution standard state, a Δμ_solvation correction must be added post-hoc.
workflow_before_submit: This is a STATIC (NSW=0) box-size sanity check. Before submitting, copy the CONTCAR from ../CH3OH_vacuum/ (the 15 Å relaxed geometry) into this dir's POSCAR, then submit. This isolates the cell-size effect from any geometry drift. Target: |E(20.0 Å) − E(15 Å)| < 5 meV.
